name: tycooncraft
title: TycoonCraft
blurb: Combine two things to discover a third, then build the factories that make them. Every name is invented on the spot.
tagline: A crafting tycoon. Rub two items together and something new comes out — named by a language model, so nobody has seen it before. Automate the ones that pay, sell the output, and buy your way up six tiers of industry.
